title: release-cindy-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified Cindy plugin release through the repository custom marketplace.

requirements.summary: Release only the Cindy adapter, verify its repository marketplace source, and publish the matching vcindy tag without an archive.
acceptanceCriteria: Only Cindy package and ghost manifest fourth segments are bumped.
The Cindy-only .claude-plugin marketplace entry points at packages/cindy-adapter/plugin.
The tagged marketplace ghost manifest is valid and matches vcindy-<version>.
No .cindy archive, GitHub Release, or npm package is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Cindy release baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, Cindy manifests, the repository marketplace entry, and every worktree change. Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Prepare and verify the Cindy source
tasks.detail: Bump only Cindy package.json and plugin/ghost.json fourth segments, validate manifest constraints, skill consistency, and the claw-kit-cindy marketplace source, synchronize required content, run focused checks, and review the complete diff.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source release gate
tasks.detail: Commit intended content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run npm run verify:release, then create and push vcindy-<version>.

tasks.title: Publish the Cindy marketplace source
tasks.detail: Verify the tagged repository marketplace resolves claw-kit-cindy to the target plugin directory and ghost.json version. Do not build a .cindy archive or create a GitHub Release; Cindy packages the source locally when the user installs or updates it.

tasks.title: Verify the Cindy release and optional install
tasks.detail: Verify tag, origin/main equality, marketplace source path, manifest version, and repository cleanliness. Only when separately requested, refresh the custom market, accept Cindy confirmation, check logs, restart, and verify enabled/running target version.

references.why: Owns manifest, marketplace, tag, publication, migration, and installation rules.

rules: Never publish npm packages or modify another adapter.
Never build or upload a .cindy archive for a marketplace release.
Never publish changed Cindy plugin bytes without increasing the manifest version.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
